subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does a private current-main reproduction demonstrate that ACP can select or execute an unapproved tool outcome before `resolvePermissionRequest` settles?
rationale: The public report alleges a serious boundary bypass, but its proposed mechanism conflicts with the inspected synchronous path and lacks enough evidence for automation to validate or dismiss a potentially different exploit path.

options.title: Request private proof
options.body: Keep the issue under security review and request a private GitHub Security Advisory containing a minimal current-main reproduction and demonstrated unauthorized outcome.

options.title: Close after security confirmation
options.body: Close as unsupported only after an ACP security owner confirms that no alternate reachable path matches the allegation and the reporter cannot provide a reproduction.

recommendation.title: Request private proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue under security review and request a private GitHub Security Advisory containing a minimal current-main reproduction and demonstrated unauthorized outcome.
